verdict.rationale: pnpm can pin and install Node.js per project via `devEngines.runtime` and switches to the pinned pnpm version from `packageManager` on first use, with no nvm or shell hooks needed. This covers project-scoped tool versions, but only for Node.js and pnpm, and only when pnpm is invoked rather than on entering the directory. Missing for 10: environment-variable activation, automatic activation on directory entry, version pinning for tools beyond Node.js/pnpm, independent corroboration.
